name: helper-callable-uses
goal: Only actual helper calls appear in a selected helper Uses tab; empty Uses is absent

evidence: Callable contract selection retains module-wide relations. Scope selected helper Uses to exact named caller facts; hide empty helper Uses and route legacy empty Uses to overview.

Existing callable contract and relation tests never combine independent sibling helpers with module dependencies. Extend their shared callable fixture and browser matrix for exact helper calls and empty Uses.
